name: play-infra
description: AWS CDK app for the Play backend — the API, and the data, media and auth it stands on (AWS + TypeScript + DynamoDB)

scripts.deploy:dev: npm run bundle && cdk deploy --all --context stage=dev
scripts.deploy:data: npm run bundle && cdk deploy PlayDataStack-dev
scripts.deploy:media: npm run bundle && cdk deploy PlayMediaStack-dev
scripts.deploy:auth: npm run bundle && cdk deploy PlayAuthStack-dev
scripts.deploy:api: npm run bundle && cdk deploy PlayApiStack-dev
